item.description:
Firstlight 0.2.5
- Fixes an interface freeze when checking for updates or resizing the menu-bar panel. - Shows Up to date in the update button for two seconds after a successful check, then restores Check now. - Makes tab changes, activity charts, loading rows and agent cards transition more smoothly, including interrupted animations. - Refines invitation progress, group-join feedback, profile Bump controls and list separators. - Improves onboarding transitions, changing text and Settings status feedback.

Firstlight 0.2.4
- Keeps invitation links through sign-in and app restarts, and accepts group links opened in the app or carried over from the invitation download page. - Joining through a group link now also makes you friends with the person who invited you. Reopening the link safely retries acceptance. - Tracks Devin Local usage from the shared Desktop and CLI history, including active minutes and token usage. - Refines agent charts, profile details, onboarding, confirmation dialogs and native controls. - Clarifies agent connection status in Settings.

Firstlight 0.2.3
- Recovers sign-in after temporary network failures and handles a Google sign-in callback that already created a valid session. - Keeps your account during token-refresh failures and retries pending activity uploads. - Reads OpenCode's current SQLite history, including live updates, without counting migrated history twice. - Adds privacy-conscious diagnostics for sign-in, updates, connectivity and app lifecycle events. - Includes the completed interface and agent-history fixes from the latest source commits.
